title: Predictive Equipment Maintenance Platform
summary: A full-stack predictive-maintenance application that uses equipment telemetry and an XGBoost classifier to predict failure risk, records telemetry and predictions in PostgreSQL, and presents results in a React dashboard.
model_notes: README says model is trained on the AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset.
README documents six input features: machine type, air temperature, process temperature, rotational speed, torque, and tool wear.
limitations: Do not imply validation on live industrial equipment without evidence.
